title: 第六十五章执法堂第六十四章和你爆了
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 第六十五章执法堂
叶凡的视线死死锁定着前方。
穿过这片密林，再翻过一道山梁，就是外门与执法堂管辖区的分界线！
只要跨过那道线，马得水就不敢再如此肆无忌惮！
那里，就是生机！
想到这里，叶凡一咬牙，不再理会身后那些骚扰性的攻击，将体内剩余的赤红色灵气尽数灌注于双腿，速度再次暴涨一截！
“他要拼命了！拦住他！”
马得水也看到了那道若隐若现的山梁，急的眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
他将自己的速度催动到极限，肥胖的身体在山路上像一个肉球般滚动，竟然第一个冲出了人群，离叶凡只剩下不到二十丈的距离！
“叶凡！你给我死来！”
马得斯一声怒吼，体内的灵气疯狂涌向右掌。
他整个人高高跃起，一掌隔空拍出！
一个由灵气汇聚而成的、磨盘大小的灰色掌印，脱手而出，带着呼啸的恶风，狠狠印向叶凡的后心！
这一掌，他用上了全力！
他自信，只要拍中，锻体境的叶凡就算不死，也绝对会筋骨寸断，彻底失去行动能力！
叶凡感受到了身后那股致命的威胁。
他能躲。
但他不能躲！
一旦躲了，速度必然会慢下来，就会被这一掌的余波震伤，彻底陷入重围。
拼了！
叶凡的眸子里闪过一抹决绝。
他能看到，就在前方不到五十步的地方，一块半人高的黑色石碑，静静的矗立在月光下。
石碑上，用朱砂刻着三个龙飞凤舞的大字。
执法堂！
只要再有三个呼吸！
然而，马得水那全力一击的掌风，已经到了他的身后，吹的他衣衫猎猎作响！
千钧一发！
就在那灰色掌印即将触碰到叶凡背心的瞬间。
一声断喝，如同九天惊雷，毫无征兆的在寂静的山林间炸响！
“住手！”
声音不大，却带着一股不容置疑的威严，仿佛蕴含着某种奇特的力量，让在场所有人的心脏都漏跳了一拍。
“执法堂界碑之前，胆敢行凶？”
话音未落，数道黑影，如同鬼魅一般，从界碑后方的密林中闪出。
content_en:
Chapter 65 Law Enforcement Hall
Ye Fan's eyes were fixed on the front.
Passing through this dense forest and climbing over a mountain ridge is the dividing line between the outer gate and the jurisdiction of the Law Enforcement Hall!
As long as he crosses that line, Ma Deshui will not dare to be so unscrupulous again!
There is life!
Thinking of this, Ye Fan gritted his teeth and ignored the harassing attacks behind him. He poured all the remaining red aura in his body into his legs, and his speed surged again!
"He's going to fight! Stop him!"
Ma Deshui also saw the looming mountain ridge, and his eyes almost popped out of his head.
He pushed his speed to the limit, and his fat body rolled like a meat ball on the mountain road. He was the first to rush out of the crowd, leaving only less than twenty feet away from Ye Fan!
"Ye Fan! Come and die!"
Mads roared angrily, and the spiritual energy in his body rushed to his right palm crazily.
He jumped up high and shot out with a palm from the air!
A gray palm print the size of a millstone, formed by the gathering of spiritual energy, came out of his hand, carrying a whistling evil wind, and stamped hard on the back of Ye Fan's heart!
He used all his strength with this palm!
He is confident that as long as the shot is successful, even if Ye Fan in the physical training state does not die, his muscles and bones will definitely be broken and he will completely lose the ability to move!
Ye Fan felt the fatal threat behind him.
He can hide.
But he can't hide!
Once you hide, your speed will inevitably slow down, you will be injured by the aftermath of this palm, and you will be completely surrounded.
Fight!
A flash of determination flashed in Ye Fan's eyes.
He could see, less than fifty steps ahead, a black stone tablet half a man tall, standing quietly in the moonlight.
On the stone tablet, three large Chinese characters with flying dragons and phoenixes were engraved in cinnabar.
Law Enforcement Hall!
Just three more breaths!
However, Ma Deshui's full-strength palm wind had already reached behind him, making his clothes rustle!
A critical moment!
At the moment when the gray palm print was about to touch Ye Fan's vest.
A loud shout was like thunder from the sky, exploding in the silent mountains and forests without any warning!
"Stop!"
The voice was not loud, but it carried an unquestionable majesty, as if it contained some strange power, making the hearts of everyone present skip a beat.
"How dare you commit murder in front of the boundary marker of the Law Enforcement Hall?"
Before he finished speaking, several black shadows, like ghosts, flashed out from the dense forest behind the boundary monument.
title_en: Chapter 65: Law Enforcement Hall Chapter 64: I broke up with you
